illustration_style: Editorial fibre-craft product photography with an original cosy autumn studio aesthetic, presenting realistically crocheted handmade pieces as premium downloadable pattern visuals.
line_quality: Not applicable; definition comes from clearly resolved yarn loops, stitch relief and softly irregular handmade contours.
detail_level: High material detail in the hero makes, with legible individual stitches, yarn twist and dimensional construction; supporting surfaces remain restrained.
character_language: When character motifs are used, render them as original compact crochet figures with rounded proportions, simple attached facial details and friendly restrained expressions.
background_density: Low to medium; clean tactile studio surfaces with a few understated seasonal texture cues, kept secondary to the crochet work.
composition: Clear single-product or small coordinated-group hierarchy, ample peripheral breathing room for optional pattern-cover titling, and uncluttered edges suitable for thumbnails.
palette: Autumnal earth tones of terracotta, ochre, moss, mulberry and warm cream, grounded with oatmeal and soft stone neutrals; use a small cool accent only where it improves colour separation.
shading: Soft diffused daylight with gentle contact shadows that reveal stitch depth; natural tonal variation rather than dramatic contrast.
texture: Central, authentic fibre texture: visible crochet loops, subtle yarn halo, soft fabric weave and lightly tactile paper-like surfaces.
mood: Cosy, tactile, polished and quietly abundant; adult craft-market warmth with a modern seasonal feel.
print_considerations: Use pale or lightly textured backgrounds, preserve fine stitch contrast at home-print scale, avoid large solid dark fields, and keep any cover text high-contrast and well clear of trimming or folding zones.
shared_prompt: Original editorial fibre-craft product photography, showing realistic handmade crochet with crisp visible loops, yarn twist, soft stitch relief and subtly irregular artisan contours. Use soft diffused daylight, gentle contact shadows and a pale tactile studio finish. Full-colour autumn earth palette of terracotta, ochre, moss, mulberry, warm cream, oatmeal and stone, with sparing cool accents; premium, cosy, modern adult craft-market mood, uncluttered hierarchy and ample breathing room. No illustrated outlines or glossy synthetic surfaces.
avoid: Any exact pumpkin forms, stitch construction, stems, colour assignments or diagonal flat-lay from the references
